name: Restaurant Le Meurice Alain Ducasse
address: Le Meurice, 228 rue de Rivoli, 75001, Paris
dinnerNote: Collection menu: five dishes, cheese and dessert (Découverte €375); Monday to Friday
dinnerNoteFr: Menu Collection : cinq plats, fromages et dessert (Découverte 375 €) ; du lundi au vendredi

menus.name: Collection menu
menus.note: Five dishes, cheese and dessert; dishes can be had in a vegetable version

menus.name: Chef's Table Initiation menu
menus.note: Private table overlooking the kitchen: a glass of Dom Pérignon and five dishes; paid in advance. The Expérience version with a vintage Dom Pérignon pairing is €925

hotel: Le Meurice, a Dorchester Collection hotel
bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms, by phone or by email (restaurant.lmp@dorchestercollection.com). Dinner only, Monday to Friday, 7pm to 9.30pm.
cancellation: A card guarantee is taken. Cancel at least 48 hours ahead, or €375 a person is charged for a late cancellation or no-show. Chef's Table bookings are paid in advance (€575 a person) and refunded if cancelled at least 48 hours ahead. Tables are held for 15 minutes.
groups: The Chef's Table, overlooking the kitchen, takes 4 to 8 people for lunch or a private dinner, by booking only. Private events through the hotel.
